headline: AC Service in Chromepet, From MIT Lanes to GST Road
intro: Chromepet packs a lot into a few square kilometres. Mid-rise flats stacked along GST Road, student rooms around the MIT campus, families near the government hospital cluster. Most homes here run a compact 1 or 1.5 ton split, and in May that unit works a twelve-hour shift. Airam AC Service keeps those machines honest, with GST-registered billing, background-verified technicians, and pricing you see before we open the panel.

The neighbourhood is tough on air conditioners. Dust from GST Road traffic cakes filters and coils within weeks of a service. Voltage dips across older blocks in Radha Nagar and New Colony stress compressors and trip PCBs. And Chennai's coastal humidity means a poorly drained unit starts dripping down a freshly painted wall by August. Our technicians see these patterns every day, so diagnosis is quick and repairs come with up to a 90-day warranty.

Chromepet households watch every rupee, and we price like we know it. A basic split service starts from ₹499, deep cleaning from ₹799, and every job ends with a digital invoice, no rounding up at the door. Our founder spent years on service calls in his father's AC business before starting Airam, so the standard is simple: fix it properly the first time. Same-day slots are available, with 60-90 minute reach across Chromepet.

challenges.title: GST Road dust chokes filters fast
challenges.description: Fine dust from GST Road traffic settles into filters and evaporator coils within weeks, cutting airflow and cooling. Homes near the main road often need a jet-wash deep clean, not just a filter rinse.

challenges.title: Voltage swings in dense mid-rise blocks
challenges.description: Evening loads across Chromepet's packed apartment blocks bring voltage dips and spikes that burn capacitors and trip PCBs. We test stabilisers and connections on every call, not just the unit.

challenges.title: Compact splits running overtime
challenges.description: The 1 and 1.5 ton units in student rooms near MIT and small family flats often run twelve-hour stretches through summer. Gas levels drop, capacitors wear, and cooling fades exactly when it is needed most.

challenges.title: Leaks from cramped installations
challenges.description: Tight balconies and short drain runs are common on Chromepet's narrow plots, so condensate backs up and drips down walls, especially in humid monsoon weeks. We re-slope drains and clear blockages properly.

testimonials.name: Vignesh S.
testimonials.quote: My 1 ton LG in Radha Nagar was cooling poorly. The technician showed me the clogged coil, did a jet wash, and cooling was back that evening. Invoice matched the quoted ₹799.

testimonials.name: Revathi M.
testimonials.quote: Our Voltas split stopped cooling during exam week. They came the same day, found low gas, and topped it up with pressure readings shown on the phone. Very professional team.

faqs.question: How soon can a technician reach my home in Chromepet?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day slots for Chromepet, with 60-90 minute reach in covered areas. Whether you are near the MIT flyover, the railway station or the hospital stretch, our technicians ride two-wheelers, so narrow inner streets do not slow them down.

faqs.question: Which parts of Chromepet do you cover?
faqs.answer: All of it: Radha Nagar, New Colony, Hasthinapuram, MIT Colony, Nemilichery and Krishna Nagar, plus the Chitlapakkam and Zamin Pallavaram borders. If your building sits off a narrow lane, that is not a problem; most of our Chromepet visits do.

faqs.question: What AC problems are most common in Chromepet?
faqs.answer: Dust-clogged filters and coils from GST Road traffic, capacitor and PCB failures after voltage dips, and drain leaks in tightly installed splits. A deep clean from ₹799 solves most cooling complaints, while PCB repair runs ₹1,499-4,999 depending on the board.

faqs.question: Do you charge more in Chromepet than in other areas?
faqs.answer: No. A basic split service starts from ₹499 and gas top-up from ₹1,499, exactly as it does anywhere else we work in Chennai. You get an upfront quote before work begins and a digital invoice after, so the price never shifts at the door.
